title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (Huifa [2007] No. 1) — marked 已修改 (amended) on the SAFE page
quote: 第二条 对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。 … 第十二条 境内个人经常项目项下非经营性购汇超过年度总额的，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料在银行办理。 … 第十四条 外汇储蓄账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含5万美元）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过上述金额的，凭经常项目项下有交易额的真实性凭证办理。
finding: Two USD 50,000 annual totals exist: one for converting FX into RMB (结汇) and one for a domestic individual buying FX (购汇), each per person per year. Above the purchase total, a domestic individual must present identity plus documents evidencing the transaction. Outward remittance from an FX savings account is ID-only up to USD 50,000 per day; above that, authenticity documents are required.

title: 关于进一步完善个人外汇管理有关问题的通知 (Huifa [2015] No. 49)
quote: 个人在办理外汇业务时，应当遵守个人外汇管理有关规定，不得以分拆等方式规避额度及真实性管理。 … （二）外汇局对以借用他人额度等方式规避额度及真实性管理的个人，列入“关注名单”管理 … （三）“关注名单”内个人的关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续2年。
finding: Splitting a transfer to get around the quota or the authenticity review is prohibited. Borrowing another person's quota puts the individual on a watch list for the current year and the two following years; on the watch list, every purchase needs ID plus supporting documents.

publisher: State Council of the PRC (国务院令第532号)
title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration)
quote: 第三十九条 … 处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 … 第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，没收违法所得，处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款 … 第五十二条（二）境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人
finding: Evading exchange control, illegally arbitraging FX, and private/indirect trading in FX each carry a fine of up to 30 percent of the amount, rising to 30-100 percent if serious, plus confiscation and possible criminal liability. A 境内个人 (domestic individual) is a Chinese citizen, or a foreign national continuously resident in China for one full year.

publisher: PBOC, published in the State Council Gazette
title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 (PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16)
quote: 第二条 … 移民转移是指从中国内地移居外国 … 将其在取得移民身份之前在境内拥有的合法财产变现，通过外汇指定银行购汇和汇出境外的行为 … 第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出 … 第八条 …（六）申请转移财产所在地或收入来源地主管税务机关开具的税收证明或完税凭证 … 第十一条 外汇指定银行办理售汇后，应直接将外汇汇往移民或继承人居住国或地区申请人本人的账户，不得在境内提取外币现钞。
finding: Emigrant property transfer and inherited-property transfer are separate capital-account routes requiring SAFE approval at the branch where the household registration was. The application must include a tax certificate or tax-payment receipt from the competent tax authority. The bank must remit directly to the applicant's own account abroad and may not hand out cash. Art. 6's staging and Art. 10's national-level filing for amounts over RMB 500,000 are superseded by S05.

title: 关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知 (Huifa [2014] No. 2)
quote: 六、简化个人财产转移售付汇管理 （一）… 取消财产转移总金额超过等值人民币50万元报国家外汇管理局备案的要求。（二）取消移民财产转移分次汇出的要求。申请人向原户籍所在地外汇局办理移民财产转移核准手续后，银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出相关资金。
finding: The requirement to file nationally above RMB 500,000 equivalent was abolished, and so was the requirement to remit an emigrant transfer in stages. After approval by the SAFE branch, the bank may remit once or in instalments within the approved amount.

publisher: SAFE and General Administration of Customs
title: 携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法 (Huifa [2003] No. 102)
quote: 出境人员携带不超过等值5000美元（含5000美元）的外币现钞出境的，无须申领《携带证》，海关予以放行；出境人员携带外币现钞金额在等值5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，应向外汇指定银行申领《携带证》… 出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元的外币现钞出境
finding: Carrying cash out: up to USD 5,000 needs no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 needs a bank-issued carrying permit; more than USD 10,000 is in principle not permitted and a SAFE permit is limited to listed special circumstances.

title: Circular on Regulating Large-sum Overseas Cash Withdrawals with Bank Cards
quote: In overseas cash withdrawals by individuals with domestic bank cards, the sum of withdrawals using the bank cards under the name of the individual (including supplementary cards) shall not exceed the equivalent of RMB 100,000 in every civil year … the ceiling for every foreign currency card per day is … the equivalent of RMB 10,000
finding: Overseas ATM withdrawals on domestic bank cards are capped at RMB 100,000 equivalent per person per calendar year and RMB 10,000 per card per day; exceeding the annual quota blocks further overseas withdrawals in the current and the next two years.

title: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知 (Yinfa [2021] No. 237)
quote: （二）虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务、虚拟货币之间的兑换业务 … 一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。（三）境外虚拟货币交易所通过互联网向我国境内居民提供服务同样属于非法金融活动。
finding: Exchanging legal tender for virtual currency as a business is an illegal financial activity and is strictly prohibited; overseas exchanges serving PRC residents over the internet are likewise illegal. Using a stablecoin to move RMB offshore therefore sits inside a prohibited activity, not a grey area.

title: 中国银行外汇牌价 (BOC FX board), USD row, published 2026/11/11 20:39:19

quote: 美元 665.91 665.91 668.71 668.71 671.91 2026/11/11 20:39:19 … 1.本汇率表单位为100外币换算人民币，仅供参考，客户办理结/购汇业务时，应以中国银行网上银行、手机银行、智能柜台或网点柜台实际交易汇率为准
finding: Per 100 USD: cash buying 665.91, spot buying 665.91, spot selling 668.71, cash selling 668.71, BOC accounting rate 671.91. The board is expressly indicative; the rate actually dealt by the channel governs. The accounting rate is not a midpoint and is not used here.

title: 中国银行电子银行个人服务转账汇款费率表 (fee schedule from 1 Nov 2014)
locator: Row 跨境汇款（电汇）; notes 1-2
quote: 跨境汇款（电汇） 每笔汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔；另收电讯费,港澳台地区人民币80元/笔,非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔。 … 1、另有协议约定、价格优惠、地方性收费差异的，按照协议或当地公示的内容收取相关费用。
finding: Online cross-border telegraphic transfer: 0.1 percent of the remitted amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260, plus a cable fee of CNY 150 for destinations outside Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan. Local pricing and discounts may differ.

title: HSBC China exchange-rate board, last updated 2026-11-10
locator: Row 美元 (USD); RMB per 1 USD
finding: Per USD: selling (cash and spot) 6.7030239; spot buying 6.6362813; cash buying 6.5997540. Indicative, subject to change without notice.

title: Tariff of Accounts and Services for Wealth and Personal Banking Business (Effective from 31 Oct 2026)
quote: Telegraphic Transfer Issuance 2.2.4.1 … Premier 0.1% of remittance amount Min. CNY100 / equivalent per transaction Max. CNY500 / equivalent per transaction Plus Cable Charge … Cable Charges 2.2.4.2 … Premier CNY120 / equivalent per cable … Global Transfer 2.2.6.1 … Premier Free … Advance CNY145 * per transaction * This is an indication charge. The actual charge per transaction will be USD20 or equivalent in other foreign currency.
finding: Premier/Advance outward TT: 0.1 percent, minimum CNY 100, maximum CNY 500, plus CNY 120 cable. Global Transfer to the customer's own HSBC account abroad is free for Premier and USD 20 for Advance. A 'Pay Exact' option costs CNY 200. Premier preferential pricing requires last month's total relationship balance of at least CNY 500,000 or equivalent. The PDF file carries an English 'Effective from 31 Oct 2026' header and, further in, a Chinese heading '2024年9月12日生效'.

publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
title: Foreign Exchange Rates — H.10, weekly, release date 9 November 2026
locator: Row CHINA, P.R. — YUAN; columns Nov. 2 to Nov. 6
finding: CNY per USD on 2-6 November 2026, as published 9 November 2026: 6.6480, 6.6701, 6.6731, 6.6680, 6.6760. Used here as the external midpoint benchmark; it is a weekly series and is not the rate any bank will deal on the day.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
quote: The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate. Generally, it accepts any posted exchange rate that is used consistently. … China | Yuan | 7.129 | 7.189 | 7.075 | 6.730 | 6.452
finding: The IRS has no official rate and accepts any consistently used posted rate. Its published yearly average for China for 2025 is 7.129 CNY per USD. The page does not publish a 2026 yearly average yet.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
locator: Who must file; When to file; Penalties
quote: A U.S. person … must file an FBAR to report: a financial interest in or signature or other authority over at least one financial account located outside the United States if the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported. … due April 15 … automatic extension to October 15 … Whether the account produced taxable income has no effect
finding: A U.S. citizen with signature authority over, or interest in, the Chinese account must file FinCEN Form 114 if the aggregate balance exceeded USD 10,000 at any point in the year, whether or not the money earned anything. The FBAR is not filed with the tax return.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
quote: Specified individuals living in the US: Unmarried individual … more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $75,000 at any time during the year … living outside the US: Unmarried individual … more than $200,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $300,000 at any time during the year … Up to $10,000 for failure to disclose and an additional $10,000 for each 30 days of non-filing … potential maximum penalty of $60,000
finding: Form 8938 thresholds depend on filing status and on whether the taxpayer lives in the US or abroad; the 8938 penalty can reach USD 60,000 per year. Form 8938 does not replace the FBAR.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table
quote: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction … 16,536 | 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) … Willful Violation of Transaction … 165,353
finding: Inflation-adjusted maximum FBAR penalties in the table displayed as current on 9 November 2026: USD 16,536 per non-willful violation and USD 165,353 per willful violation. The table's own column heading still reads 'assessed on or after January 17, 2025'.

title: Gifts from foreign person
quote: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report the receipt of such gifts or bequests only if the aggregate amount received … exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year. If the gifts or bequests exceed $100,000, you must separately identify each gift in excess of $5,000. … exceeds $20,116 for 2025, and $20,573 for 2026
finding: A transfer from a foreign relative is not automatically tax-free income and is not automatically taxable either: if it is a genuine gift from a nonresident alien, the recipient files Form 3520 once the aggregate from that person exceeds USD 100,000 in the year. Transfers from foreign companies or partnerships have a much lower threshold.

publisher: State Taxation Administration (Shanghai tax service, official text)
title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (Individual Income Tax Law), as amended 2018
quote: 第一条 在中国境内有住所，或者无住所而一个纳税年度内在中国境内居住累计满一百八十三天的个人，为居民个人 … 第三条（一）综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率 …（三）… 适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。 … 第十六条 … 所得为人民币以外的货币的，按照人民币汇率中间价折合成人民币缴纳税款。
finding: A tax resident (domiciled, or present 183 days in a tax year) is taxed on worldwide income. Rates: 3-45 percent progressive on comprehensive income; 20 percent flat on interest, dividends, property rental, property transfer and incidental income. The statute lists income categories and does not list a currency conversion as an income event.

title: 中华人民共和国税收征收管理法 (Tax Collection and Administration Law)
quote: 第三十二条 … 从滞纳税款之日起，按日加收滞纳税款万分之五的滞纳金。 … 第六十三条 … 是偷税。对纳税人偷税的，由税务机关追缴其不缴或者少缴的税款、滞纳金，并处不缴或者少缴的税款百分之五十以上五倍以下的罚款
finding: Late tax carries a surcharge of 0.05 percent per day. Tax evasion (including a false filing or refusing to file after notice) carries recovery of the tax plus surcharge and a fine of 50 percent to 5 times the tax underpaid.

title: Foreign Tax Credit
quote: If you paid or accrued foreign taxes to a foreign country or U.S. possession and are subject to U.S. tax on the same income, you may be able to take either a credit or an itemized deduction for those taxes. … If you are entitled to a reduced rate of foreign tax based on an income tax treaty … only that reduced tax qualifies for the credit. … A foreign tax credit may not be claimed for taxes on income that you exclude from U.S. gross income
finding: The credit is conditional ('may be able to'), is limited to foreign income taxes, and only the treaty-rate tax qualifies. No credit is allowed against excluded income. The page does not describe the credit as dollar-for-dollar.

publisher: U.S. Government Publishing Office (U.S. Code, 2024 edition)
title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
quote: any foreign currency gain or loss attributable to a section 988 transaction shall be computed separately and treated as ordinary income or loss … In the case of any disposition of any nonfunctional currency— (I) such disposition shall be treated as a section 988 transaction, and (II) any gain or loss from such transaction shall be treated as foreign currency gain or loss
finding: Selling CNY for USD is a disposition of nonfunctional currency and therefore a section 988 transaction; the exchange-rate gain or loss is ordinary income or loss, not capital. A loss is likewise ordinary.

title: Rev. Proc. 2026-35 (2027 adjusted items)
quote: .41 Foreign Earned Income Exclusion. For taxable years beginning in 2027, the foreign earned income exclusion amount under § 911(b)(2)(D)(i) is $137,300. … .46 (1) For calendar year 2027, the first $20,000 of gifts to any person … .51 … exceeds $21,240.31
finding: For tax years beginning in 2027 the foreign earned income exclusion is USD 137,300; the annual gift-tax exclusion is USD 20,000; the section 6039F reporting threshold is USD 21,240.31.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
quote: Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP). … When families or groups are involved, the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual.
finding: Carrying more than USD 10,000 into or out of the US requires FinCEN Form 105, and the threshold applies to the group's combined amount, not per traveller. Failure risks seizure and civil or criminal penalties.

group: Commercial provider terms (not a government source)
title: Guide to CNY transfers
locator: Sending from CNY — who can send, limits
quote: You can send money from CNY if: You're not mainland Chinese … You're working or have worked in China before … You have a valid tax record issued by the China tax authority showing taxes paid within the last 3 years … If you're sending CNY from your China bank app, the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY … your overall limit is the amount of salary you've earned in China after deducting the amount of tax paid in China.
finding: Wise's CNY-out service requires a PRC tax record and sets the overall limit from salary minus tax paid; a single bank-app transfer is capped at CNY 300,000, and the money can only go to an account the sender owns. The page publishes no fee figure.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）
quote: 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬如何购汇汇出？答：根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条规定，“境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇”。
finding: A foreign individual's lawful current-account RMB income earned in China is converted at the bank on identity plus documents evidencing the transaction, including tax documents, under Huifa [2020] No. 14 Art. 59. This is the foreign-individual article, not the domestic-individual annual total in S01.

publisher: Internal Revenue Service (US–China income tax convention, with Senate documents)
title: United States–People's Republic of China Income Tax Convention (1984, in force 1 January 1987)
locator: Letter of Submittal, 24 July 1984, paragraphs on source rules
quote: Business profits will not be taxable by China unless attributable to a "permanent establishment" … Taxation by China of the remuneration of United States citizens who are self-employed or employed by private firms is generally permissible only if they remain in China more than six months a year. In addition, the agreement limits the tax which each country may impose on dividends, interest and royalties derived by residents of the other country to no more than 10 percent in each case.
finding: The 10 percent ceiling applies to dividends, interest and royalties only. It is not a general 10 percent cap on Chinese tax on a US citizen's income, and it does not cover salary or capital gains. Remuneration is addressed separately, by the six-month presence test.
